Broad 1/2 and min/max guarantees do not imply the sharp optimum. Research-record and local historical statements checked for equivalents/stronger implication. No claim of universal uniqueness, residual unindexed-equivalence risk remains.

value.rationale: Natural smallest three-day recurring two-good identical-valuation obstruction motivated by explicit approximation-gap statements in Choi-Li 2026. The exact sharp three-day uniform factor (>0.78) substantially strengthens the general 1/2 guarantee in this tightly structured market; exact H/L feasibility threshold for every horizon and the balancing-vs-bundling optimizer transition explain the mechanism. Not a gratuitous numerical slice or known-table recomputation; no claim about general arbitrary goods or long-horizon approximation.
